example.title: Brookings County Museum, farm equipment building

brief: Post-frame steel machine shed about 36 ft wide and 48 ft deep, sheathed in barn-red ribbed steel with white corner and eave trim and a low gable roof of galvanized steel. A big white ribbed-steel sliding door fills most of the gable end, beside a white steel man door; a newer lean-to runs down one long side. On the farm it holds the tractor and combine head; the example carries a museum sign board, which here would be a plain farm name board. An old iron hay-rack frame lies in the grass beside it.
